facts.fact: The Eswatini Observer reports Oracle Innovate Lab, an accelerator delivered by Thinkroom Consulting with Oracle Group Eswatini, launched its second cohort of four businesses at the Oracle CX Hub in Mbabane after a first cohort of six, with mentorship, masterclasses and pitch preparation.
